title: on windows fullname() returns "No Instance(s) Available"
description:
Dear whoami developers, 

great package, thank you. Unfortunately, I have to report a problem on Windows with whoami.
I am using the version 1.3.0 of whoami. 

About my system:
```
> sessionInfo()
R version 4.3.1 (2023-06-16 ucrt)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
Running under: Windows 10 x64 (build 19044)
```

If called on a Windows machine that has no connection to his domain controller (maybe the reason, but I have no possibility to check if connecting it to the domain controller fixes the issue soon), `whoami::fullname()` does not return the username (except if specified in Git), but `"No Instance(s) Available"` instead. 

![issue2](https://github.com/r-lib/whoami/assets/51724507/d8cb0d8f-0b26-466a-a392-721e130084a9)

![issue1](https://github.com/r-lib/whoami/assets/51724507/0d4e8427-9ea0-4517-963b-02c40aef3e5f)

To work around this bug, I have configured my git name, but less advanced users may not even have git. 
Thank you for your help,

title: Move `master` branch to `main`
description:
The `master` branch of this repository will soon be renamed to `main`, as part of a coordinated change across several GitHub organizations (including, but not limited to: [tidyverse](https://github.com/tidyverse), [r-lib](https://github.com/r-lib), [tidymodels](https://github.com/tidymodels), and [sol-eng](https://github.com/sol-eng)). We anticipate this will happen by the end of September 2021.

That will be preceded by a release of the [usethis package](https://usethis.r-lib.org), which will gain some functionality around detecting and adapting to a renamed default branch. There will also be a blog post at the time of this `master` --> `main` change.

The purpose of this issue is to:

* Help us firm up the list of targetted repositories
* Make sure all maintainers are aware of what's coming
* Give us an issue to close when the job is done
* Give us a place to put advice for collaborators re: how to adapt

*message id: euphoric_snowdog*

title: Fault-tolerance?
description:
So I added `whoami` to `pkgKitten` to populate `DESCRIPTION` in a better way.

Turns out that is not such a good idea Travis for two reason.  First, it adds a huge tail of `Depends:` :-/ which I can probably avoid the `r-cran-*` route.  But second, it finds nothing on empty systems:

``` .R
* checking tests ...
  Running ‘simpleTest.R’
 ERROR
Running the tests in ‘tests/simpleTest.R’ failed.
Last 13 lines of output:


    demo(simpleDemo)
    ---- ~~~~~~~~~~

  > library(pkgKitten)

  > setwd(tempdir())                        # which gets deleted anyway

  > kitten("simpleTest")                    # unfortunately testing fails :-/
  Error in whoami::fullname() : Cannot determine full name
  Calls: demo ... withVisible -> eval -> eval -> kitten -> ifelse -> <Anonymous>
  Execution halted
* DONE
Status: 1 ERROR
See
  ‘/home/travis/build/eddelbuettel/pkgkitten/pkgKitten.Rcheck/00check.log’
for details.
The command "./travis-tool.sh run_tests" exited with 1.
Done. Your build exited with 1.
```

Can we do better, or do you suggest I wrap this in `tryCatch()` at my end?
